app.name: FlavorQuest
app.tagline: Discover Vinh Khanh cuisine through audio

metadata.title: FlavorQuest - Discover Vinh Khanh Cuisine
metadata.description: Automatic guided audio tour to explore Vinh Khanh food street, Can Tho. Offline-first PWA with multi-language support.

manifest.name: FlavorQuest - Automatic Audio Tour Experience
manifest.description: Explore Vinh Khanh food street with location-based automatic audio narration. Supports 18 languages, works offline.

settings.title: Settings

settings.deviceProfileDescription: FlavorQuest automatically adjusts motion, map details, and background loading to suit your device.
settings.deviceProfileAutoDescription: Let the app automatically balance motion, map detail, and background loading for your current device.
settings.deviceProfileLightDescription: Reduce effects and limit background loading to prioritize battery life and stability.

settings.deviceProfileFullDescription: Prioritize smooth motion and wider preloading when your device has spare capacity.
settings.deviceProfileBatteryHint: Battery saver mode is making the active profile one notch more conservative.

welcome.description: Discover Vinh Khanh food street with automatic audio narration
welcome.step3: Narration automatically plays when near food spots

splash.subtitle: Discover the Vinh Khanh Culinary Journey

login.title: FlavorQuest Login
login.subtitle: Save your progress and sync your experience
login.prompt: Enter your email to receive an OTP code for login
login.ownerApprovalNote: Owner login requires admin approval first. After OTP verification, you will be taken to a pending approval page and can directly chat with admin.
login.codeSent: OTP code has been sent to your email.
login.sendOtpError: Unable to send OTP. Please try again.
login.verifyOtpError: OTP verification failed. Please try again.
login.adminPortalRequired: Admin accounts must log in via the dedicated admin portal.
login.changeEmailHint: You can edit your email and resend the code if entered incorrectly.

pendingOwner.titlePending: Account is pending admin verification to unlock owner access
pendingOwner.titleRejected: Your owner request requires more discussion with admin
pendingOwner.subtitlePending: This account is in pending owner approval state and cannot use customer or owner areas yet. The chat thread below is the main place to track and respond if admin needs further verification.
pendingOwner.subtitleRejected: Admin has rejected the current request. You can still continue the conversation below to provide more context or verification info.
pendingOwner.customerHint: While waiting for approval, this account can only track status and chat with admin.

request.title: Your request has been recorded
request.body: The system has created a chat thread with admin so you can provide extra verification info if needed.

review.title: Admin will verify via chat
review.body: Watch for messages here to respond quickly if admin needs more details before approval.

reviewRejected.body: The previous request was rejected. You can continue chatting below to clarify further.

workspace.title: Owner workspace will open after approval
workspace.body: Once approved, you will enter the owner area. If no shop is assigned yet, the owner screen will remain empty until admin assigns at least one POI.

menu.title: Food Menu
menu.empty: This shop has not updated its menu yet.
menu.pickupDescription: You pick up food at the shop and pay upon receipt.
menu.deliveryDescription: The shop delivers food to your provided address and you pay upon delivery.
menu.pickupTimeFuture: Please select a future pickup time
menu.deliveryTimeFuture: Please select a future delivery time
menu.deliveryContactRequired: Please enter the name, phone, and delivery address

chatbot.title: FlavorQuest Assistant
chatbot.subtitle: Suggest dishes, stops, and answer questions for your trip.
chatbot.welcome: I can suggest dishes to try, places to stop, and answer common questions right here in FlavorQuest.
chatbot.inputPlaceholder: Ask what to try, where to go first, or how to use the app...
chatbot.pageSubtitle: A dedicated place to ask about dishes, suitable tours, and how to use FlavorQuest without covering the map or POI list.
chatbot.pageInfoBody: The assistant uses current FlavorQuest data to suggest dishes, stops, and suitable routes, and answer common questions while you explore.
chatbot.error: Assistant is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
chatbot.footer: Suggestions are based on current FlavorQuest data.

suggestions.food: What dishes should I try first today?
